findings.evidence: page is 1100px wide at a 375px viewport (sideways scroll); widest culprit 1100px
findings.title: No horizontal overflow
findings.fix: Find the overflowing element; use min-width: 0, overflow-wrap, and avoid 100vw.

findings.evidence: T-FILLER: "$48.2k", "3,910", "1.8%", "62" with deltas "↑ 12%", "↑ 4%", "↓ 2%", "↑ 7% from last month" and no period, source or empty/loading state. The header promises "updated in real-time" while every delta is month-over-month.
findings.after: Bind to real data with an as-of timestamp, and design the empty and loading states (INT-159); in a mock, mark figures as sample data
findings.why: A dashboard is the place figures must be true; round invented KPIs with confident deltas are fake data presented as state.
findings.title: No invented metrics
findings.fix: Use the real number, a visible [DATA NEEDED] slot, or nothing.

findings.evidence: Sub-line says "changes are saved automatically" directly above a "Save Changes" button. One of the two is false.
findings.before: "Manage your account preferences — changes are saved automatically" + [Save Changes]
findings.after: Pick one model: autosave with a visible "Saved" trace (CMP-147) and no button, or an explicit Save with no autosave claim
findings.why: Contradictory save copy is the mark of text and UI generated separately; users cannot tell whether their change persisted.
findings.title: Never confirm success before it happened

findings.after: Cite each figure, use only supplied facts, or remove the band.

findings.evidence: focus.json: no :focus or :focus-visible rules in the CSS; every stop uses the default 1px auto ring. On "Save Changes" (indigo-violet gradient) and the indigo "Delete Account" a 1px dark ring has little contrast against the fill.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast.
findings.title: Visible focus everywhere
findings.fix: Use :focus-visible with a 2px ring offset 2px in a contrasting colour.

findings.evidence: Emoji are part of the text: h1 reads "bar chart Analytics Dashboard", the labels "money bag Revenue", "busts in silhouette Active Users", "chart decreasing Churn", "star NPS", and the sub-line ends "rocket".
findings.after: Remove the emoji, or wrap each in <span aria-hidden="true">
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content and 2.4.6: decorative symbols pollute heading and label names.
findings.title: Images have text alternatives
findings.fix: Write what the image tells the reader, or alt="" if it tells nothing.

findings.evidence: "↑ 12% from last month", "↓ 2% from last month" are all the same grey #9ca3af; whether a change is good or bad (churn down is good, others up are good) is conveyed by nothing but the arrow glyph, and the arrow is read as "upwards arrow".
findings.after:
↑ Up 12% from last month
; raise colour to at least #4b5563
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 1.4.3 Contrast: direction must be in text, and the text must meet 4.5:1 (sweep measured 2.54:1).
findings.title: Text contrast on real pixels
findings.fix: Darken text or lighten ground; never thin weights on tinted ground.

findings.evidence: "Delete Account" sits 4px from "Save Changes", filled in the same brand indigo, in an unstyled browser-default bevel with a 21px target, plus a 🗑️ emoji button beside the email field that deletes something unnamed.
findings.before: [Save Changes][Delete Account] side by side, both indigo
findings.after: Move "Delete account" to a separate danger zone below, styled as a secondary/outline red control (CMP-122), with an undo or typed confirmation
findings.why: A destructive action styled and placed like the primary action is the opposite of a decision; the half-styled button shows nobody looked.
findings.title: Separate dangerous items (delete account, log out) from normal ones

findings.evidence: Value "user@example.com" shown as the account email.
findings.after: Bind to the signed-in user's email; in a mock, use an obviously sample address
findings.why: Placeholder identity in an account screen reads as unfinished.
findings.title: Ban fake contact data: example.com/.example addresses printed as real, phone numbers of ze

findings.evidence: 3 font families render: Inter, Noto Color Emoji, Liberation Sans
findings.title: Sizes on a declared ladder
findings.fix: Collapse sizes to the scale; drop the extra family.

findings.evidence: Each card is label div + value div + delta div with no structure; a screen reader reads a run of "Revenue $48.2k up 12% ... Active Users 3,910 ..." with no grouping.
findings.after: <dl> per card (<dt>Revenue</dt><dd>$48.2k</dd><dd>Up 12% from last month</dd>), or a <section aria-label="Key metrics"> with an h2
findings.title: Headings and landmarks
findings.fix: Fix levels in markup and size with CSS.
